text: The verifier SHALL accept an OpenAPI 3.x document supplied as either YAML or JSON and parse it into an internal operation list.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: OpenAPI document loading

text: When the caller passes a file ending in `.yaml` or `.yml`, parse it as YAML.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: OpenAPI document loading › Scenario: A YAML document is supplied › THEN[1]

text: When the caller passes a file ending in `.yaml` or `.yml`, produce one internal operation entry per path-and-method pair.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: OpenAPI document loading › Scenario: A YAML document is supplied › AND[2]

text: When the caller passes a file ending in `.json`, parse it as JSON.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: OpenAPI document loading › Scenario: A JSON document is supplied › THEN[1]

text: When the caller passes a file ending in `.json`, produce the same internal operation list as the equivalent YAML.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: OpenAPI document loading › Scenario: A JSON document is supplied › AND[2]

text: The verifier SHALL build exactly one request per operation, preferring the `example` values declared in the document and falling back to values generated from the parameter or schema type when no example is given.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Request generation per operation

text: When an operation's parameters and request body all declare `example` values, use those example values verbatim in the generated request.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Request generation per operation › Scenario: An operation declares examples › THEN[1]

text: When an operation parameter has a type but no `example`, generate a value of that type (string, integer, boolean, array, object).
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Request generation per operation › Scenario: An operation declares no examples › THEN[1]

text: The verifier SHALL check that each response's status code is documented for that operation and that the response body validates against the schema the document associates with that status code.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Response validation

text: When the service returns a status code not listed for the operation, mark the operation failed.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Response validation › Scenario: An undocumented status code is returned › THEN[1]

text: When the service returns a status code not listed for the operation, record the returned status and the list of documented statuses.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Response validation › Scenario: An undocumented status code is returned › AND[2]

text: When the response body omits a field the schema marks as required, mark the operation failed.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Response validation › Scenario: The response body is missing a required field › THEN[1]

text: When the response body omits a field the schema marks as required, record the missing field's name.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Response validation › Scenario: The response body is missing a required field › AND[2]

text: The verifier SHALL attach the caller-supplied bearer token to the `Authorization` header of every request it sends, without modification.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Authentication passthrough

text: When the caller provides a bearer token, every generated request carries `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Authentication passthrough › Scenario: A bearer token is supplied › THEN[1]

text: The verifier SHALL record the operation, the expected value, and the actual value for every failed check, and SHALL continue checking the remaining operations.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Failure handling

text: When an operation's response fails a check, append its failure detail to the report.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Failure handling › Scenario: An operation fails midway through a run › THEN[1]

text: When an operation's response fails a check, proceed to the next operation without aborting the run.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Failure handling › Scenario: An operation fails midway through a run › AND[2]

text: The verifier SHALL send no more than 25 requests per second to the target service.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Rate limiting

text: When the document contains more operations than the per-second limit, spread the requests so no one-second window exceeds 25 requests.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Rate limiting › Scenario: A large document is verified › THEN[1]

text: The verifier SHALL retry a failed request up to three times with exponential backoff before marking the operation failed.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Retry on transient failure

text: When a request receives an HTTP 503 response, retry the request after a growing delay, up to three attempts.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Retry on transient failure › Scenario: A request returns 503 › THEN[1]

text: When a request receives an HTTP 503 response, mark the operation failed only if all attempts fail.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Retry on transient failure › Scenario: A request returns 503 › AND[2]

text: The verifier SHALL emit a single JSON report containing the run totals (operations checked, passed, failed) and a per-operation detail list.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Report format

text: When every selected operation has been checked, write a JSON object with `checked`, `passed`, and `failed` counts.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Report format › Scenario: A run completes › THEN[1]

text: When every selected operation has been checked, include a `operations` array with one entry per operation and its result.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Report format › Scenario: A run completes › AND[2]

text: The verifier SHALL skip `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, and `DELETE` operations unless the caller explicitly enables write operations.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Write-operation protection

text: When the caller does not pass `--include-writes`, exercise only `GET` and `HEAD` operations.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Write-operation protection › Scenario: Writes are not enabled › THEN[1]

text: When the caller does not pass `--include-writes`, list each skipped write operation in the report as `skipped`.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Write-operation protection › Scenario: Writes are not enabled › AND[2]

text: The verifier SHALL run up to 8 operations concurrently to reduce total run time.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Parallel execution

text: When more than 8 operations remain to be checked, keep 8 requests in flight at once until the queue drains.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Parallel execution › Scenario: A run has many independent operations › THEN[1]

text: The verifier SHALL delete any resources it creates during a write-enabled run before the run finishes.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Created-resource cleanup

text: When a `POST` operation creates a resource during the run, issue the corresponding `DELETE` for that resource before reporting.
source_ref: spec.md › Requirement: Created-resource cleanup › Scenario: A write-enabled run creates a resource › THEN[1]
